# hue_light (Data Source)

Look up a Hue light by UUID. Missing resources are errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hue_light" "desk" {
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource UUID.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (String) Owner device UUID, suitable for room children.
- `gamut_type` (String) A, B, C, or other; null for a light without color.
- `mirek_max` (Number)
- `mirek_min` (Number)
- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `supports_color` (Boolean)
- `supports_color_temperature` (Boolean)
